profile.subtitleJa: ナイル流域を中心とする古代の国・地域名
profile.summaryJa: 2 Chronicles 1:16では、ソロモンの馬がエジプトから運ばれたと記されます。ここでは特定の都市ではなく、国・地域を指す広域名です。

facts.textJa: エジプトから戦車や馬が輸出され、ヒッタイト人やシリア人の王にも送られたと記されます。
契約の箱には、イスラエルの民がエジプトを出たときの契約の石板が納められていたと記されます。
神殿建設についての祈りは、民をエジプトから導き出した出来事に言及します。
神殿奉献の祈りの中で、エジプトから導き出された民が神に背いた場合が語られます。
ソロモンの支配範囲を述べる文に、エジプトとの境が含まれます。
ソロモンの馬がエジプトから運ばれたと再び記されます。
ヤロブアムはソロモンから逃れてエジプトにいた後、帰還したと記されます。
レハブアムの治世第5年、エジプト王シシャクがエルサレムへ攻め上ったと記されます。
シシャクとともにエジプトから来た軍勢が記されます。
シシャクはエルサレムで神殿と王宮の財宝を奪ったと記されます。
ヨシャファトの祈りは、エジプトから出た際にイスラエルがアンモン、モアブ、セイル山の人々を攻めなかったことに触れます。
ウジヤの名声がエジプトの入口にまで及んだと記されます。
ヨシヤの時代、エジプト王ネコがユーフラテス川沿いのカルケミシュへ向かったと記されます。
エジプト王がエホアハズを退け、国に貢納を課したと記されます。
エジプト王ネコはエリアキムを王に立て、エホアハズをエジプトへ連れて行ったと記されます。

profile.modernLocationJa: ナイル川流域を中心とする北東アフリカの地域名です。聖書時代の範囲を現代エジプトの国境と同一視できません。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 王の交易記事に、馬の供給地として現れます。
profile.locationNoteJa: 現代の正確な所在地・座標は独立に確認できていません。地図に表示される場合も、従来資料に由来する未確定の参考位置です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.
They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.
There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there, and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel;

They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”
He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.
When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against the LORD,
with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;
The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.
After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.
The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
